newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BRL Hardy expands in two states.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BRL Hardy expands in two states.

text.p: Winemaking group BRL Hardy Ltd said on Sunday it planned a A$3.8 million expansion of its Leasingham winery in the Clare Valley region of South Australia.
The expansion, which includes a new vintage cellar, tank press and increased storage, would boost processing capacity and allow greater flexibility in blending, the group said.

BRL Hardy said it would also spend an initial A$250,000 to improve visitor facilities at Brian McGuigan Wines' Hunter Ridge facility in the Hunter Valley in New South Wales. The move follows a recent strategic alliance between the two companies.
